args.description: 150 x 30 x 30 mm steel sensor arm along x. Fully fixed x=0 face bolted flat to robot frame. Camera weight modeled as total 20 N along -y uniformly distributed over centered 20 x 20 mm end-face patch at x=150 (y,z=5..25). Plate represented by its load footprint; no unspecified plate thickness or passive solid added. Steel E=210000 N/mm^2, nu=0.3; volume fraction 0.25; 1 mm elements.
